versions.short: The resolution expresses the Senate's support for the goals and ideals of National Forensic Science Week and recognizes it as a chance for forensic science providers to thank their scientists and hold community events, for local leaders to honor and visit their local crime labs and proclaim the week of September 20 to 26, 2026, for the public and media to attend lab events, tour facilities, and report on local lab work, and for police, law enforcement, and court officers to tour labs and discuss their needs and how to work together more effectively.
